sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "firearms" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "manufacturer" TEXT NULL, "model" TEXT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "default_cartridge_id" TEXT NULL, "sight_notes" TEXT NULL, "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "cartridges" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "projectile_diameter_mm" REAL NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "built_in" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("built_in" IN (0, 1)), "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ammo_lots" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "cartridge_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cartridges (id), "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "manufacturer" TEXT NULL, "product_name" TEXT NULL, "lot_number" TEXT NULL, "bullet_weight_grains" REAL NULL, "projectile_type" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ranges" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "location_description" TEXT NULL, "is_indoor" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_indoor" IN (0, 1)), "available_distances_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "notes" TEXT NULL, "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "training_sessions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "started_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "local_utc_offset_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ended_at_utc" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "photo_safety_acknowledged_at_utc" INTEGER NULL, "range_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES ranges (id), "training_goal" TEXT NULL, "conditions" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shooting_series" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES training_sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "sequence_number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_profile_versioned_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_profile_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "distance_meters" REAL NOT NULL, "projectile_diameter_mm" REAL NOT NULL, "cartridge_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES cartridges (id), "shot_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "maximum_possible_score" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "firearm_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES firearms (id), "ammo_lot_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES ammo_lots (id), "notes" TEXT NULL, "total_score" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "inner_ten_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "miss_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "score_penalty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "scored_bull_count" INTEGER NULL, "has_boundary_warnings" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("has_boundary_warnings" IN (0, 1)), "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "confirmed_at_utc" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "image_assets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES training_sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "series_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES shooting_series (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "role" TEXT NOT NULL, "path" TEXT NOT NULL, "sha256" TEXT NOT NULL, "width" INTEGER NOT NULL, "height" INTEGER NOT NULL, "size_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "caption" TEXT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "vision_scan_drafts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "original_image_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "sha256" TEXT NOT NULL, "width" INTEGER NOT NULL, "height" INTEGER NOT NULL, "size_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "target_profile_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "projectile_diameter_mm" REAL NOT NULL, "quality_json" TEXT NULL, "registration_json" TEXT NULL, "candidates_json" TEXT NULL, "review_json" TEXT NULL, "engine_version" TEXT NULL, "failure_code" TEXT NULL, "rotation_quarter_turns" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "alignment_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'fullCard', "anchors_json" TEXT NULL, "reprojection_rms_mm" REAL NULL, "reprojection_max_mm" REAL NULL, "planarity_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown', "alignment_algorithm_version" TEXT NULL, "alignment_confirmed_at_utc" INTEGER NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "vision_analyses" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "series_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shooting_series (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "image_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES image_assets (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "engine_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "backend_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "model_version" TEXT NULL, "quality_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "registration_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "candidates_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "review_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shot_impacts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "series_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shooting_series (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "x_mm" REAL NOT NULL, "y_mm" REAL NOT NULL, "source_image_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES image_assets (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "image_x_normalized" REAL NULL, "image_y_normalized" REAL NULL, "multiplicity" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "is_miss" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_miss" IN (0, 1)), "is_position_uncertain" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_position_uncertain" IN (0, 1)), "target_bull_id" TEXT NULL, "score_value" INTEGER NOT NULL, "raw_score_value" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "score_disposition" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'counted', "is_inner_ten" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_inner_ten" IN (0, 1)), "is_boundary_uncertain" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_boundary_uncertain" IN (0, 1)), "placement_method" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', "vision_analysis_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES vision_analyses (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "positional_uncertainty_mm" REAL NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "photo_alignments" ("image_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES image_assets (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "corners_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "matrix_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "algorithm_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "rotation_quarter_turns" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "alignment_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'fullCard', "anchors_json" TEXT NULL, "reprojection_rms_mm" REAL NULL, "reprojection_max_mm" REAL NULL, "planarity_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown', "confirmed_at_utc" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("image_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "goals" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_profile_versioned_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "distance_meters" REAL NOT NULL, "firearm_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES firearms (id), "ammo_lot_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES ammo_lots (id), "metric" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_value" REAL NOT NULL, "comparison" TEXT NOT NULL, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "series_reflections" ("series_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shooting_series (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "perceived_quality" TEXT NOT NULL, "context_tags_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("series_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "coach_feedback" ("insight_fingerprint" TEXT NOT NULL, "rule_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "rule_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "response" TEXT NOT NULL, "snoozed_until_utc" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("insight_fingerprint"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "preferences" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "target_profiles" ("versioned_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "validation_status" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "built_in" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("built_in" IN (0, 1)), "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("versioned_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "training_activities" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "schema_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES training_sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "configuration_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "summary_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "detector_version" TEXT NULL, "started_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "local_utc_offset_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "completed_at_utc" INTEGER NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "training_activity_series_links" ("activity_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES training_activities (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "series_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shooting_series (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "sequence_number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "role" TEXT NULL, "variant_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("activity_id", "series_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shot_timer_events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "activity_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES training_activities (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "sequence_number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "elapsed_microseconds" INTEGER NOT NULL, "split_microseconds" INTEGER NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "disposition" TEXT NOT NULL, "normalized_peak" REAL NULL, "detection_quality" TEXT NULL, "exclusion_reason" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "timer_presets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "configuration_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "built_in" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("built_in" IN (0, 1)), "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "acoustic_calibration_profiles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "firearm_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES firearms (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "cartridge_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES cartridges (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "environment" TEXT NOT NULL, "audio_route" TEXT NOT NULL, "sample_rate" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sensitivity" REAL NOT NULL, "echo_lockout_microseconds" INTEGER NOT NULL, "beep_blanking_microseconds" INTEGER NOT NULL, "detector_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
